rule: S_N must not be null (mandatory one-to-one join key)
rationale: S_N serves as a one-to-one join key with Acc_Info_dirty and is a mandatory identifier with 0% missing values in the sample

rule: Every S_N in Cust_Bio_dirty must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N
rationale: S_N is defined as a one-to-one key with Acc_Info_dirty.S_N; referential integrity must be enforced before joining

rule: Account_No must not be null (mandatory account identifier)
rationale: Account_No is a mandatory business identifier with 0% missing values; required for account linking

rule: Account_No must be a 4-digit code
rationale: Evidence shows all values are 4 characters long (1001-1028); stored as int64 but intended as string with fixed 4-digit format

rule: Name must not be entirely lowercase or entirely uppercase (should be Title Case)
rationale: Sample contains case deviations: 'lim wei jie' (all lowercase) and 'WANG SHI JIE' (all uppercase); standard requires Title Case like 'Lim Wei Jie'

rule: Name particles indicating gender must match the Gender column: Bin/s/o indicate Male; Binte/d/o indicate Female
rationale: Cultural naming conventions in Singapore (Malay/Indian) encode gender: 'Bin' and 's/o' indicate male, 'Binte' and 'd/o' indicate female; mismatches suggest data quality issues

check_params.logic:
import re
name = str(row['Name'])
gender = str(row['Gender']).strip().lower()
male_match = bool(re.search(r'\bBin\b', name, re.IGNORECASE)) or bool(re.search(r'\bs/o\b', name, re.IGNORECASE))
female_match = bool(re.search(r'\bBinte\b', name, re.IGNORECASE)) or bool(re.search(r'\bd/o\b', name, re.IGNORECASE))
(male_match and gender != 'male') or (female_match and gender != 'female')

rule: ID_No must not be null (mandatory national identification)
rationale: ID_No is a mandatory identification field with 0% missing values; required for identity verification

rule: ID_No must follow Singapore NRIC format: one letter (S/T/F/G), 7 digits, one uppercase letter (e.g., S8403757E)
rationale: 93.3% of values follow pattern [STFG]XXXXXXX[A-Z]; anomalies include '1916569C' (missing prefix) and 'F212233V' (6 digits); standard Singapore NRIC requires exactly 7 digits

rule: Race must be one of: Chinese, Malay, Indian
rationale: Evidence shows only three semantic categories with case variations; all values should conform to this standard domain set

rule: Race must be in Title Case (not all uppercase or all lowercase)
rationale: Observed case inconsistencies: 'MALAY', 'malay', 'indian' should be standardized to 'Malay', 'Indian', 'Chinese'

rule: Gender must be either Male or Female
rationale: Binary classification field with observed values Male/Female (with case variations); domain constraint requires these two values only

rule: Gender must be in Title Case (Male/Female, not male/FEMALE)
rationale: Observed case inconsistencies: 'male' and 'FEMALE' deviate from standard Title Case format 'Male' and 'Female'

rule: Age must be parseable as an integer (no text representations like 'Twenty-five')
rationale: Column contains non-numeric text value 'Twenty-five' (3.3% of records) which cannot be parsed as integer; requires standardization to numeric format

rule: Age must be between 0 and 120 (valid human age range)
rationale: Domain constraint for human age; observed values include -5 (impossible) and 4 (unrealistic for service account); negative ages are invalid

rule: Age below 13 is unrealistic for a service account
rationale: Evidence indicates age values 4 and potentially others below 13 may be unrealistic for this service dataset; requires business confirmation

rule: Contact_No must not be null (contact information required)
rationale: Column has 6.7% missing values (2 NULLs); contact number is typically mandatory for customer records

rule: Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number: +65 prefix optional, 8 digits, starting with 3, 6, 8, or 9
rationale: Singapore phone numbers observed with country code 65; valid local numbers are 8 digits starting with 3 (VoIP), 6 (landline), 8 or 9 (mobile); anomaly '8964359' has only 7 digits

rule: Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no whitespace (basic structural validation)
rationale: 13.3% of records have malformed emails: missing @ ('not-an-email', 'useremail.com'), spaces ('zx91 @example.com'), or double @ ('nabilah@@example.com')

rule: Country must be standardized to 'Singapore' (flag abbreviations, alternative languages, or case variants)
rationale: Eight distinct representations of Singapore observed (Singapore, Singapura, S'pore, SG, 新加坡, etc.); standardization required to canonical form 'Singapore'

rule: Street_Name must not be in all uppercase (should be Title Case)
rationale: Observed deviation: 'HOLLAND ROAD' is all uppercase; standard requires Title Case like 'Holland Road'

rule: Postal_Code must not be null (mandatory address component)
rationale: Postal code is mandatory for address validation with 0% missing values; required for geographic standardization

rule: Postal_Code must be a 6-digit code
rationale: Singapore postal codes are strictly 6 digits; observed lengths of 4 (6907) and 5 (99999) digits indicate missing leading zeros or invalid entries

rule: ID_No must exactly match the ID value in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: S_N is a one-to-one key; the national ID should be consistent across both tables for the same individual

check_params.semantic_check: ID_No must match ID from Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N

rule: Name must match Full_Name from Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N (allowing for case differences)
rationale: S_N is a one-to-one key; customer name should be consistent across Cust_Bio_dirty and Acc_Info_dirty; observed discrepancies like 'Danish Bin Kamaruddin' vs 'Danish' require validation

check_params.semantic_check: Name must match Full_Name from Acc_Info_dirty (case-insensitive comparison) for the same S_N
